items.title: Pensacola mayor: Isaias caused at least $70M in private-property damage in city
items.summary: Pensacola Mayor D.C. Reeves said at his Wednesday weekly press conference (Oct 14) that city private property owners have reported an estimated $70 million in Hurricane Isaias damage through Escambia County's Citizen Damage Report tool - the first city private-property estimate, expected to rise as assessment teams continue. Reeves said the figure is critical to meeting FEMA individual-assistance designation criteria. Separate figure: Escambia County announced Oct 13 a $64M initial estimate for county-owned buildings/facilities (not private property); Pensacola's city-owned-building assessment is still underway.
